Google.title: Directory Sync
Google.content:
# Directory Sync

Given two directory structures represented as trees, write a function to synchronize them by outputting the minimal number of create, delete, and move operations required to make the destination tree identical to the source tree.

Google.title: Meeting Rooms III
Google.content:
# Meeting Rooms III

You are given an integer `n` and an array `meetings` where `meetings[i] = [start_i, end_i]`. Allocate meetings to rooms such that the number of rooms used is minimized, and return the room that held the most meetings.

Meta.title: Sticker Combination
Meta.content:
# Sticker Combination

You are given a set of sticker words. Return the minimum number of stickers required to spell out a target word.

Meta.title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
Meta.content:
# Kth Largest Element in a Stream

Design a class to find the kth largest element in a stream of numbers.

Netflix.title: Content Delivery Cache
Netflix.content:
# Content Delivery Cache

Design an LRU cache with an expiration time for each key. The cache should automatically evict expired keys when full.

Amazon.title: Package Delivery Routing
Amazon.content:
# Package Delivery Routing

Find the shortest path to deliver a package in a grid with obstacles and traffic.
